title: SiegeSectors
description: Capture sectors and dominate the battlefield
body:
## 🎮 Game Overview

**SiegeSectors** is a strategic team-based minigame where attackers and defenders clash over multiple sectors.

> It is recommended to play this minigame with castle maps.

---

## ⚔️ How It Works

There are 2 teams:

- 🔴 **Red Team – Attackers**
- 🔵 **Blue Team – Defenders**

### At the start:

- Defenders control **3 sectors** *(configurable)*
- They spawn in the **first sector**

---

## 🧩 Core Mechanics

### 🛡️ Defenders

- Must protect their sectors **in order**
- When a defender dies:
  - They lose the **current sector**
  - They fall back to the **next sector**
- If they lose the **final sector** → **they lose the game**

---

### ⚔️ Attackers

- Must capture sectors **one by one**
- When all attackers die:
  - They retreat to the **previous sector**
- If they have **no sector left** → **they lose the game**

---

## 🔄 Gameplay Flow

- Defenders start with **full control** of all sectors
- Attackers push to capture the **current sector**
- The eliminated team **retreats**
- The battle continues until one team **cannot retreat**

---

## ⚙️ Features

- ⚙️ Configurable sector system *(add/remove sectors)*
- 🔁 Push & retreat mechanics
- 🧠 Simple but highly strategic design
- 🚧 Actively developed *(beta)*

---

## 🧪 Beta Notice

This plugin is currently in **beta**.

This means that new features will be added over time.  
Your feedback and reviews are highly appreciated during this phase!

---

## 💬 Feedback

Have ideas, suggestions, or found a bug?
